name: IdentityCell
description:
The two-line identity cell: a status-dotted glyph, the name, and a data subtitle. It is
EntityIdentity's row tier, so a table's identity column is the same object as the
entity's header, tree row and chip. The row owns the actions (⋯ and right-click), so the
cell is passive. Used as the title column of entity tables and as the card title.
signature: ({ title, subtitle, icon, status, statusLabel }: IdentityCellProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: icon
props.description: Entity glyph. Defaults to the endpoint monitor. Pass the icon without a size.

props.name: status
props.description: Live state, drawn as the shared status dot on the glyph's corner.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Accessible text for the status dot. Defaults to the state's name ("Online").

props.name: title
props.description: The entity's name: hostname, person, organisation.
